notes: All 28 played matches come from ESPN's ita.coppa_italia feed: preliminary round 4 (8-9 Aug 2026), first round ('trentaduesimi') 16 (14-17 Aug), second round ('sedicesimi') 8 (1-3 and 15 Sep). Results confirmed by legaseriea.it (Tier 1: round articles, highlight titles) and, where its pages named only the winner, by Sky Sports (Vicenza-Catania, Ascoli-Potenza, Benevento-Ravenna) or Corriere dello Sport's match pages (Monza-Avellino, Torino-Carrarese, Cremonese-Sampdoria, Pisa-Empoli; Corriere added as Tier 2). Every first-round winner is in the second round.

Format (legaseriea.it, 'La Coppa Italia Frecciarossa entra nel vivo con i trentaduesimi'): 44 clubs (20 Serie A, 20 Serie B, 4 Serie C); single matches; a draw after 90 minutes goes straight to penalties, so shoot-outs are stored as PEN with noExtraTime (Corriere dello Sport's match pages show no extra time in Vicenza-Catania and Pisa-Empoli). Italian pages give a shoot-out as a total ('Sassuolo-Frosinone 5-4 d.c.r.' = 1-1 and 4-3 on penalties).
